findings.finding: Initial repository contained a single 6-byte file (`# NFL2`, no trailing newline) and zero data pipelines, schemas, or site assets.
findings.resolution: Documented as baseline audit state; full multi-session dashboard and verification scripts added.

findings.finding: Root build linked `https://www.nfl.com/injuries/league/2026/REG9` (Week 9) while labeling it 'Official NFL Injury Report — Week 10'. Official Week 10 URL is `REG10`.
findings.resolution: Corrected to `https://www.nfl.com/injuries/league/2026/REG10` and ingested all 14 Week 10 games (222 player rows) in `data/full-injuries-week10-2026.json`.

findings.finding: Row `NO at CHI` in the 8-column Week 11 Originated-Lines table had only 7 `<td>` cells (missing 8th cell), shifting column alignment.
findings.resolution: Fixed column count to 8 `<td>` cells and added per-row official NFL.com source links.

findings.file_or_commit: strategies.html, lines-lab.html, suggestions.html, questions.html, executive-summary.html (PR #1) & docs/*.html (PR #4)
findings.severity: High — Verification Rule Gap (Table Rows Without Official Source Links)
findings.finding: Project rule requires every `<tbody><tr>` row to carry a source link to an official site. Several framework/register/methodology tables lacked per-row official links.
findings.resolution: Added verified official source links (`nfl.com`, `operations.nfl.com`, `itl.nist.gov`, `github.com/kanlerxz87-cyber/NFL2`) to 100% of table rows and enforced via `scripts/verify_site.py`.

findings.file_or_commit: Official NFL.com REG10 Injury Report vs. Official NFL.com News / IR Transactions
findings.severity: High — Upstream Official Source Blindspot (Flagged for Review)
findings.finding: `nfl.com/injuries/league/2026/REG10` shows 'No Injuries Reported' for SEA, CIN, LAC, and BAL at snapshot time — yet NFL.com official news confirms SEA QB1 Sam Darnold is ruled out, CIN S Kyle Dugger was DNP Wednesday, and BAL QB1 Lamar Jackson + QB2 Tyler Huntley are on IR.
findings.resolution: Cross-joined REG10 report with official NFL.com IR/starter news and club depth charts; flagged on `flagged.html` so models never treat 'No Injuries Reported' as '100% starters healthy'.

findings.severity: Medium — Club PR Disclaimer & Roster Lag (Flagged for Review)
findings.finding: Club websites explicitly label depth charts 'Unofficial' (compiled by club PR/writers); e.g., `miamidolphins.com` has a blank Kicker (`K`) cell, `commanders.com` omits OUT C Lucas Patrick, `giants.com` omits Questionable LB Malik Harrison, and `therams.com` still lists retired DE Aaron Donald.
findings.resolution: Documented verbatim with club disclaimers and flagged on `flagged.html` and `depth-deficiencies.html` — never blindly ingest club depth charts without cross-checking active 53-man roster & 90-min inactives.

findings.severity: Low — Dual Root + docs/ Deployment Structure
findings.finding: GitHub Pages repository configuration is `build_type: legacy` serving `/` on `main` (`https://kanlerxz87-cyber.github.io/NFL2/`), while `.github/workflows/pages.yml` uploads `docs/` artifact (also reachable at `/NFL2/docs/`).
findings.resolution: Preserved both root and `docs/` sites intact with zero deleted files, cross-linked them cleanly, and verified 100% of pages and links across both.
